title: An LLM-Assisted Multi-Objective AutoML Framework for Efficient Network Intrusion Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.28312v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conventional Machine Learning (ML)-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) require manual design, optimize only detection performance, and neglect inference latency and model size, which are critical for resource-constrained Internet of Things (IoT) and Electric Vehicle Charging System (EVCS) deployments. Automated ML (AutoML) reduces manual effort but explores broad search spaces inefficiently. Meanwhile, Multi-Objective Optimization (MOO) methods lack guided search initialization, leading to long search times. translated_title: 一种用于高效网络入侵检测的大语言模型辅助多目标AutoML框架
translated_abstract: 传统的基于机器学习（ML）的入侵检测系统（IDS）需要人工设计，且仅优化检测性能，忽略了推理延迟和模型大小，而这些因素对于资源受限的物联网（IoT）和电动汽车充电系统（EVCS）部署至关重要。自动化机器学习（AutoML）虽然减少了人工工作量，但对广阔搜索空间的探索效率低下。同时，多目标优化（MOO）方法缺乏引导式搜索初始化，导致搜索时间过长。本文提出了一种大语言模型辅助的多目标自动化机器学习（LLM-MOO-AutoML）框架，用于高效入侵检测。本地部署的Llama 3.1 8B模型分析紧凑的数据集概况，并生成有界的、经过验证的策略，用于自动化数据平衡（AutoDP）和特征工程（AutoFE）。该策略缩小了非支配排序遗传算法III（NSGA-III）的搜索空间，从而联合优化……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个由本地Llama 3.1 8B模型辅助的多目标AutoML框架（LLM-MOO-AutoML），利用大语言模型生成数据平衡与特征工程策略以缩小NSGA-III的搜索空间，从而高效地训练出兼顾检测性能、推理延迟和模型大小的网络入侵检测模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-MOO-AutoML framework in which a local Llama 3.1 8B model generates validated data balancing and feature engineering policies to narrow the NSGA-III search space, enabling efficient training of intrusion detection models that jointly optimize detection performance, inference latency, and model size for resource-constrained IoT and EVCS deployments.
